name: American Front
description: White supremacist organization founded in San Francisco, California by Bob Heick in 1984. Originally modeled after the British National Front, it later transformed into a political organization with skinhead and non-skinhead members. The group held White Workers Day marches and published the tabloid Aryan Warrior. By 1989, it had units in 14 American states.
